disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia spectrum disorder; diagnoses confirmed using the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Our final sample included 211 healthy controls (ranging in age from 15 to 58) and 234 individuals with a schizophrenia spectrum diagnosis (ranging in age from 17 to 61)."
disorder-name.location: Huang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Study participants and procedures, Schizophrenia cohort paragraph

dataset-of-origin.detail: Collected at a single location (Vanderbilt University Medical Center) from a repository study comprising participants in three neuroimaging projects (CT00762866, R01MH070560, R01MH102266). Three scan parameter groups were used at the same site.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The Schizophrenia Cohort was collected at a single location with three sets of parameters (see Supplemental Materials)."
dataset-of-origin.location: Huang2024.pdf.md: Methods / Neuroimaging data acquisition and preprocessing

age.detail: From Table 1 (Schizophrenia Spectrum column). Note: the abstract states '17–61 years' but Table 1 reports Min=15.6, Max=60.5; table values used as primary source. Supplementary Table 5 also references 'ages 15–61' for the schizophrenia group.
